text: Tammy at Ricci is a hair Goddess!  Styles and colours are on fleek. Could not live her more.

I've been going to Ricci hair for the past year and haven't been disappointed. Make your appointment with Reanne and you won't regret it! Complimentary beverages and everyone there is extremely nice. The stylists aren't afraid to give you suggestions that could improve your look from what you wanted either. Definitely worth the drive for me!

I just went a saw Larissa here. She was great. I'm new to the city, so she filled me in on where to eat and what to do. I had a great time... and my hair looks friggen great. I am so happy with how it all turned out!

Confession time: so I normally just go to Walmart and get my hair trimmed every few months.  So going to an actual salon was a total treat. 

Ricci Hair company is located just off St. Albert trail in a small strip mall. The decor is very modern urban.

My hair stylist name was Danielle and she was a total gem. Despite being over ten years my junior she was super easy to chat with. She took her time with my cut and communicated with me throughout to make sure I was getting what I came in for. She also took her time to style my hair and finished off by giving me a couple samples of products she used today. 

I think I may have to give up my cheap Walmart hair cuts as this girl left me feeling like a million bucks and I came out with a cut that was exactly what I asked for.

Also she let me know that they consciously try to be environmentally friendly by recycling as much as possible, dispose of chemicals  were necessary and using products that are environmentally friendly as well.

I am NEVER returning to this place for a haircut. I scheduled an appointment at 9:30am and requested a specific hairdresser and then at 9am when I had already left the house to go to the appointment they call me and ask me to come in two hours later. I agree and when I get there it is a completely different person which I should've never agreed to let her cut my hair. She proceeded to wash my hair and soaked my entire back and then gave me layers which I did not want.
Terrible service and terrible haircut.

Not gonna lie, I'm very critical when it comes to my hair and struggle to find stylists who can get it right. 
Thankfully, Karen has never let me down. She understands my personality and I can giver her a direction with a lot of free reign and it always turns out amazing!!!
Karen did my first ever extreme cut and colour from untouched dirty blonde hair down my back to platinum bobs and purple asymmetrical cuts she does it all.
She is also easy to talk to and always offers what you need. If my hair is looking damaged she recommends a hair treatment, if I'm going fir a particular style or look she gives me pointers on how to achieve. It also never feels like she is yanking my hair out when she brushes and blow drys, which I truly appreciate!
The colour bar is amazing also!!! If you want the right colour go here!!!!

Thanks Ricci your awesome!
